generalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have registered under Professions Tax Act and furnish corresponding Certificate of registration.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

The tenderer shall scan & upload all the Original documents required for this bid to the e-procurement portal. The Original documents shall produce at the time of opening of bid for physical verification.
Unbalanced tenders should include Security deposit amount and unbalanced amount that is difference of amount put to tender and quoted amount
The contractor should visit the site before uploading the tender and get the letter duly signed by concerned AEE.
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for these costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement 2.0 Portal
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties and the departments shall not be responsible for safety of labours.

All the items in the tender includes all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, transportation labour, hire charges of machinery, curing for concrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer- in-charge of this work.
The bidder should follow all terms and conditions of tender document.
